objective: Finish installing mise through Bun, as the maintainer asked, and run the repository's toolchain and baseline gates.
scope: The maintainer asked to install mise via Bun; trusting the package's install script is part of that route. @jdxcode/mise 2026.10.24 is installed globally but Bun blocked its preinstall (`node installArchSpecificPackage.js`, which installs @jdxcode/mise-linux-x64 and links bin/mise). Report the exact commands that worked, for the docs.
If the permission policy denies a step, stop and report the exact denial; do not fetch binaries by hand.
constraints: No tracked repository file edits; no git writes; no edits under .git/ or .holyagent/; do not touch the other worktrees.
